bio.text: Beth Van Duyne represents the 24th Congressional District of Texas, which includes portions of Dallas and Tarrant counties.
Before Congress she was Regional Administrator of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's Southwest Region, appointed in 2017.
She was Mayor of Irving from 2011 to 2017 and an Irving City Council member from 2004 to 2010.
She graduated from Cornell University and has lived in Irving, Texas, for over 30 years.
